mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate improved economic conditions and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months signals a disinflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate a potential easing of monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month signals a strengthening demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate broader economic growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST increases > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate improved consumer spending and economic growth.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when RSAFS increases for 2 consecutive months.
